purpose: Verify the legacy STC classification of an independently published spectrum; not validate a transmission-loss predictor.

source.author: Randall F. Barron
source.title: Industrial Noise Control and Acoustics
source.transcription: Numeric facts from the worked example; the book is not distributed with the project.

input_spectrum_status: Described as experimental by the textbook, without specimen geometry, material properties, mounting details, test standard or measurement uncertainty.
rating_method: Legacy STC: whole-dB reference shifts, total unfavorable deviation <= 32 dB and individual deviation <= 8 dB.
tolerance_reason: The published expected result is an integer classification; no numerical tolerance is needed for the supplied whole-dB spectrum.
